snapshot_metadata.query: SELECT l.pundit_name, l.pundit_id, l.extracted_claim, r.binary_correct, r.resolved_at, r.brier_score FROM gold_layer.prediction_ledger l JOIN gold_layer.prediction_resolutions r USING (prediction_hash) JOIN nfl_dead_money.pundit_registry pr ON l.pundit_id = pr.pundit_id AND pr.published = TRUE WHERE r.resolution_status IN ('CORRECT','INCORRECT') ORDER BY r.resolved_at DESC LIMIT 10
